articles.title: Experience Doja Cat’s Concert in VR
articles.text:
What if you could sit front row at a Doja Cat concert without leaving your living room?

We’ve partnered with The Diamond Bros to produce and direct an exciting new immersive concert experience, Doja Cat: The Scarlet Tour in VR . The concert will premiere in VR on Saturday, January 20 at 5:00pm PT, in Meta Horizon Worlds’ Music Valley.

VR concerts in Meta Horizon Worlds’ Music Valley change the game for experiencing your favorite artists’ performances. They’re free for Quest headset owners and always guarantee you a front-row seat, fully immersed in all the action of the show.

Filmed at the sold-out Detroit stop of Doja Cat’s debut arena tour, this VR concert will feature Doja’s most popular songs from The Scarlet Tour including “Paint the Town Red,” “Agora Hills,” “Woman,” and more. Experience the gigantic spider looming above Doja Cat during her performance and see the full band and fire pyrotechnics, right in your living room.

The VR concert will be available exclusively in Meta Horizon Worlds’ Music Valley, which offers the ultimate musical festival experience in virtual reality. This free social experience is available for Meta Quest VR headset owners in select regions.

RSVP for the event , and if you’re unable to join on January 20, replays will be available for another couple weeks in Meta Horizon Worlds after the concert.
